name: Bloodbound Etchings raises Blood Shield's regeneration effects by 50% (#2161)
contract: Bloodbound Etchings 570758 has both effects over EffectSpellClassMask (268435456, 0, 0) = word 0 bit 28 = Blood Shield 504296 and no other family-26 row. Effect 0 is aura 108 with MiscValue 12 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT2 -> effect index 1) and BasePoints 49 + DieSides 1 = +50%; Blood Shield's effect 1 is aura 88 MOD_HEALTH_REGEN_PERCENT with value 50, so it becomes 75. Effect 1 is aura 108 with MiscValue 23 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT3 -> effect index 2), +50%; Blood Shield's effect 2 is aura 116 MOD_REGEN_DURING_COMBAT with value 100, so it becomes 150. Tooltip: "Your Blood Shield now increases your health regeneration by an additional $s1%." Both operations are percentage modifiers, so "an additional 50%" is 50 -> 75, which is what Spell.dbc authorises. Regression guard for native behaviour.
